name: wos-onboarding
description: Workflow OS first-run setup and Suite 2 Beta upgrade guidance. Creates local workflow-os-data only for a new profile, requires Jira and Documentation setup, guides optional plugin selection, and routes existing profiles to the profile-preserving migration assistant.

interface.shortDescription: 🧩 v1.0.2 · Jira/Documentation setup and Suite 2 upgrade
interface.longDescription: Workflow OS Onboarding runs first-time setup only when no usable profile exists. Suite 2 Beta keeps existing profiles intact, requires Jira and Documentation setup, recommends Memory Lite as the native-memory companion, and provides a one-action retirement assistant for legacy Engine and DR artifacts.
defaultPrompt: Run $welcome to set up Workflow OS.
Run $suite-2-migration to upgrade my existing Workflow OS profile.
